create_random_sampler: create a RandomSampler to randomly sample elements from a PyTorch dataset with optional replacement
use_random_sampler_set_epoch: use the RandomSampler set_epoch method to seed random sampling for a specific training epoch
create_distributed_batch_sampler: create a DistributedBatchSampler to wrap any PyTorch sampler with distributed batch splitting across ranks
use_distributed_batch_sampler_wrap_last: use the DistributedBatchSampler with wrap_last enabled to handle incomplete final batches in distributed training
review_distributed_batch_sampler_batch: review the DistributedBatchSampler _batch method to understand how samples are partitioned per worker rank
